lanes.name: project-linux
lanes.scope: All existing Linux project suites plus inventory/gate tests; real PostgreSQL mandatory.

lanes.name: project-windows
allowedSkips: PostgreSQL: seven owned databases, 42 denied cross-service connections, forced tenant RLS, atomic outbox/inbox and full contract provisioning
isolated secret initialization is private and never overwrites or reuses an environment
secret generation rejects symlink ancestors and deployment rejects unsafe mounts
concurrent secret initializers cannot combine staging and production credentials
production renderer fails closed without evidence, with untested images or reused staging hosts
lanes.scope: Windows portability matrix. PostgreSQL and POSIX-only logical gates are mandatory in project-linux, not duplicated here.

lanes.name: native-verify
allowedSkips: PostgreSQL: seven owned databases, 42 denied cross-service connections, forced tenant RLS, atomic outbox/inbox and full contract provisioning
lanes.scope: Preserved native workflow project verification. PostgreSQL logical gate is mandatory in project-linux.

lanes.name: backend-runtime
lanes.scope: Actual isolated Docker/PostgreSQL/RabbitMQ journey with synthetic development authentication; not hosted OIDC.

lanes.name: native-android
lanes.scope: Unsigned native verification harness: Gradle lint/unit/build and emulator instrumentation, not signed release or physical device acceptance.

lanes.name: native-ios
lanes.scope: Xcode simulator native verification harness, not signed release or physical device acceptance.

lanes.name: identity
lanes.scope: Existing real Keycloak 26.8.2 suite using disposable loopback TLS fixture; no hosted credentials.

lanes.name: security
lanes.scope: Current npm advisory audit at high/critical threshold plus narrow materialized-secret scanning; no claim of comprehensive security review.

policy.matrixExclusions: Only the exact listed redundant platform skips are accepted. Their logical gates execute in Linux with no skips; totals remain reported.
policy.signedRelease: Separate protected manual release gate; credentials/hosted staging/physical devices not invented or treated as CI success.
policy.coverage: Instrumentation and exhaustive business workflow coverage remain unmeasured; targets are not achievements.
policy.scopeChanges: Any change to this contract requires CODEOWNERS review and a complete new FULL-CI run.
